subject: general
question: The Sangameshwara Temple had been submerged in the backwaters of the Srisailam project due to heavy rainfall in the monsoon of 2024. This temple lies on the banks of which river?
solution: The correct answer is __**Krishna**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Sangameshwara Temple** is located in the **Srisailam region** on the banks of the **Krishna River**. • It is one of the ancient temples in India, known for its religious and architectural significance. • The temple is part of the **Srisailam shrine complex**, which is a prominent pilgrimage site, especially for those following **Hinduism**. • During the monsoon of 2024, heavy rainfall caused water levels to rise significantly, leading to the submersion of the temple in the backwaters of the **Srisailam Project**. • The temple, built in the **Chola** and **Vijayanagara** architectural style, has been a site of cultural and religious importance, and the flooding raised concerns about the loss of such heritage.
